From the grill

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

A meze house on the Protaras road

Yiasemi Meze and Grill sits on the main road through Protaras, under a green sign with white letters. Its logo carries jasmine flowers (yiasemi is the Greek word for jasmine). In the restaurant’s own words: local meze restaurant, daily dishes, homemade food. On Google, guests mention the portions, the moussaka, the meze and the calamari most often.

Open every day from half past eleven in the morning until half past eleven at night. Takeaway and delivery as well.
